cast.name: UV Rays
cast.description: small angry golden-orange sun-ray villain (with White Cast and Dullness at his side) attacking the woman's cheek; smug, sneering, gloating cartoon-villain voice, should sound menacing and theatrical

cast.name: Judge DERMDOC Tube
cast.description: the white DERMDOC Ultra Violet sunscreen tube as the courtroom judge with a gavel and white-gloved hands; deep, grave, authoritative judge voice, measured and commanding

cast.name: SPF Shield
cast.description: cobalt-blue SPF 50 PA+++ shield character acting as the defence lawyer; confident, punchy, persuasive cartoon lawyer voice

cast.name: Purple Tint
cast.description: lavender droplet witness character; sweet, cheerful, bubbly higher cartoon voice

cast.name: Niacinamide
cast.description: silver-lavender niacinamide character (drawn as a silver droplet in the video) acting as the expert witness; bright, smart, gentle cartoon voice

lines.speaker: uv_rays
lines.en: Her skin doesn't stand a chance!
lines.bn: হা, ওর স্কিনের আর কোনো চান্সই নেই!
lines.or: ତା ସ୍କିନ୍ ପାଇଁ ଆଉ କିଛି ଚାନ୍ସ ନାହିଁ!

lines.speaker: spf_shield
lines.en: Evidence number one: UVA and UVB protection.
lines.bn: প্রমাণ নম্বর এক, ইউভিএ আর ইউভিবি প্রোটেকশন!
lines.te: సాక్ష్యం నంబర్ వన్, యూవీఏ, యూవీబీ ప్రొటెక్షన్!
lines.ml: തെളിവ് നമ്പർ വൺ, യൂവിഎ, യൂവിബി പ്രൊട്ടക്ഷൻ!
lines.or: ପ୍ରମାଣ ନମ୍ବର ଏକ, ୟୁଭିଏ ଆଉ ୟୁଭିବି ପ୍ରୋଟେକ୍ସନ୍!

lines.speaker: purple_tint
lines.en: Evidence number two: no ashy-looking finish.
lines.bn: প্রমাণ নম্বর দুই, কোনো অ্যাশি ফিনিশ নেই!
lines.ta: ஆதாரம் ரெண்டு, ஆஷி ஃபினிஷ் கொஞ்சம் கூட இல்ல!
lines.te: సాక్ష్యం నంబర్ టూ, ఆషీ ఫినిష్ అస్సలు ఉండదు!
lines.ml: തെളിവ് നമ്പർ ടൂ, ആഷി ഫിനിഷ് ഒട്ടുമില്ല!
lines.or: ପ୍ରମାଣ ନମ୍ବର ଦୁଇ, ଆଶି ଫିନିସ୍ ଆଦୌ ନାହିଁ!

lines.speaker: niacinamide
lines.en: And I help brighten dull-looking skin.
lines.bn: আর আমি ডাল স্কিন ব্রাইট করতে হেল্প করি!
lines.te: ఇక డల్ స్కిన్ బ్రైట్ చేయడంలో హెల్ప్ చేస్తా!
lines.ml: ഡൾ സ്കിൻ ബ്രൈറ്റ് ആക്കാൻ ഞാൻ സഹായിക്കും!
lines.or: ମୁଁ ଡଲ୍ ସ୍କିନ୍‌କୁ ବ୍ରାଇଟ୍ କରିବାରେ ହେଲ୍ପ କରେ!

lines.speaker: judge
lines.bn: রায় হলো, প্রোটেক্টেড আর ফ্রেশ দেখতে স্কিন!
lines.ml: വിധി, പ്രൊട്ടക്റ്റഡ്, ഫ്രഷ് ആയി തോന്നുന്ന സ്കിൻ!
lines.or: ରାୟ ହେଲା, ପ୍ରୋଟେକ୍ଟେଡ୍, ଫ୍ରେସ୍ ଦେଖାଯାଉଥିବା ସ୍କିନ୍!

notes: Video is 17.0 s (prompt planned 20 s); all 7 scripted lines spoken in order, no Whisper hallucinations. Judge (product tube) speaks lines 2, 6, 7 with the lowest voice (131-184 Hz); fx left at none on purpose so the judge keeps a grave, authoritative, human-like gravitas that contrasts with the three bouncy cartoon heroes. UV Rays (line 1, 229 Hz) gets villain fx -3 st. SPF Shield (193 Hz) and Niacinamide (202 Hz) are close in pitch, so Niacinamide +1 st and Purple Tint +2 st to keep the three heroes distinct. In the video Niacinamide is drawn as a silver droplet rather than a molecule. Line 1 slot runs into the 1.2 s silent gap before the judge (cap-flip transition).
